plan: Drive: from Atlin, about 48 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Atlin Hwy.
Park: 59.90605, -133.80502, pull off on Hitchcock Rest Area (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 13 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 414 m, about 291 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 120 m S of the spot at 735 m (59.91374, -134.02746). Water: unnamed wetland 30 m SW (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Aug, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-27, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-03, closures 2026-10-16.
R6T-moose-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-27: about 439 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.06 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
